overall: The AG found the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by posting notice of its January 11 meeting less than 48 hours in advance, rejecting an emergency justification, and ordered compliance and member training.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission met on January 11 without posting notice 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice 48 hours in advance of the January 11 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law ordered.
All members of the Commission ordered to attend an Open Meeting Law training webinar within 90 days of receipt of the letter.
Caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Commission that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
